New decision "Chose bidirectional prefix matching with a 4-char floor in BOTH backends' getByCommitHash over tool-layer canonical-SHA retry alone" relates to:
- 01KHMSETGFP24CH93J2R7KC97A: "All state stored as .jsonl and .json files in .twining/ directory — no external databases"
- 01KHMSEXTVQSX1G92H6MR82QVG: "Embeddings must be lazy-loaded and fall back gracefully to keyword search if ONNX/transformers fails"
- 01KHMV0F547RBYZ2854EFTM3ZC: "PlanningBridge as separate engine module, not inline in ContextAssembler"
- 01KJD595ETVSHV91ZBGRKPWWZY: "Three-layer analytics: local value stats, tool call instrumentation via registerTool patch, opt-in PostHog telemetry"
- 01KJJGD37CDKWQE5VFJYW8DGFR: "Add Stream View as alternate visualization for Blackboard tab"
- 01KKNE772KYNY55NZ3N6PM0D2H: "Auto-populate knowledge graph from tool calls via GraphAutoPopulator"
- 01KKNE7FA2Q7EFFPGX34K7RPHH: "Replace computeGraphConnectivity with computeGraphReachability using typed BFS and adaptive weight fallback"
- 01KM2B5R2YW8G820RC35Z8TX20: "Assemble output includes structured markdown briefing and inline status summary"
- 01KM2B5Y6D1YQVHER5F1SARJHD: "Graph auto-population disabled by default (opt-in via graph.auto_populate config)"
- 01KM85240NSH8HHVG66VMK36EC: "Add assumptions field to Decision type for assumption-based validation in assemble output"
- 01KQ0VBWYKNP65S6HR21J0X296: "Added matchAll with /g flag for rejection-pattern extraction and two new pattern classes: (a) labelled rejections ('Alternative rejected: X.' / 'Rejected: X.') and (b) numbered-list items ('(1) X, (2) Y, (3) Z, (4) W') scoped to contexts that contain 'rejected' or 'alternatives'. Deduplication by lowercased content prevents 'over Y' + 'instead of Y' from double-counting the same option."
- 01KQWJMWCVXYD14YGWJ9S1G943: "Snapshot file lives at .twining/.last-known-branches.json"
- 01KWK9KTZGR2V148HJJ2CGY3ZY: "SQLite is the runtime store and git is the replication transport — twining.db is a gitignored derived cache, the committed truth is a per-record export tree"
- 01KWK9KV0HV77BFQM6X4KT9V58: "Ship the SQLite backend opt-in (storage.backend config, warn-and-fallback) on node:sqlite instead of bumping engines or adding better-sqlite3"
- 01KWK9KV18QWQHTC1Z6G9BMDR6: "Extract storage interfaces (src/storage/interfaces.ts) and type engines against them, because private fields make the concrete class types nominal"
- 01KWK9KV3WQYCMZN41A1MMEWKE: "Format version gate ships and soaks before any format change: config version newer than the release puts the server in read-only mode (FORMAT_VERSION_TOO_NEW) instead of silently diverging"
- 01KWT95BYE0YQFAK2TTQP0RQHC: "Implemented the v2 default backend flip as an "auto" sentinel in DEFAULT_CONFIG resolved at createStores time, not a blind default change"
- 01KWT95C2E0WF5Q31ZTDYV6GE9: "DEVIATION from proposal: fresh init stamps backend by sqliteAvailable() (sqlite/version-2 when available, files/version-1 otherwise) instead of stamping sqlite unconditionally"
- 01KWX1P1T62JZN49DB6QNH1NG4: "Chose a new sibling test file test/config-priority-weights.test.ts over extending test/config-version-gate.test.ts"
- 01KWX2BSECJ6ZPE9MAPK89WGK1: "Merge logic lives in the blackboard-tools handlers, with decisionEngine + decisionStore passed via the options object; no new methods on DecisionEngine"
- 01KX3HED3KW6DDKQW7G0PGFBGB: "Chose to require a server-side query layer (pagination, scope/type/time filters, aggregation endpoints) as the foundation of any dashboard scale redesign over pure client-side fixes"
- 01KX4PQMHN49PCYC1E5VSTXMZX: "Fixed the final-review findings inline rather than dispatching a fix subagent"
- 01KY72PJM6R0TYN5ZXZ1RHWBAR: "Chose to mandate the unfiltered blackboard read as the resolution corpus (archiver's pattern) over scope/type-narrowed reads"
- 01KY74M5ZS6H6VCGRQ8541YDMM: "Gated twining_triage at the server.ts call site (if (fullSurface) registerTriageTools(...)) rather than an options.fullSurface param inside the register function"
- 01KY752JWXPW651SX7HZQN5PNK: "Chose to test only the pure exports (formatAge, truncationLabel, deepLinkHash, itemBadges, groupRows) in test/dashboard/triage-view-logic.test.ts"
- 01KY793EEA2DWBG2Z3TZZD9KBP: "Accepted the §8 dashboard refresh-wiring test gap (mount fetch, change-gated store.subscribe refetch, tab-activation refetch untested) as repo convention"
- 01KZ4YGXX25X40550HF7ES90GP: "Chose to delete the bare /not/ rejection pattern outright rather than replace it with the narrower appositive form"
- 01KZC2MT8JJKT362C7WDTA2PS8: "Chose to verify the rationale_source marker by reading exported record JSON rather than tool output"
- 01KZZ8ZMQR5YC69KZEX5A6JQYN: "Chose to route survivor property-folding through addRelation's own upsert rather than a direct property write"
- 01M014D4NYJZJQ8874B6VYSAKY: "Chose capture-before-delete in ExportingGraphStore.removeRelations (unlink only ids the store actually held) matching the adjacent removeEntities pattern"
- 01M04FDJ1C510F7Z08ZDB2NY54: "Chose read-back verification in override() (post-state echoed in the result, PERSIST_FAILED thrown on a lost write)"
- 01M090A2KK2S9WN1R2TERM1SDZ: "Chose handler-level validation for record's empty-summary rejection over zod-only"
